question: Should OpenClaw publish a public OpenAPI/Swagger contract for Gateway programmatic access, and if so should it be a static artifact, an authenticated runtime endpoint, or a documented TypeBox/JSON Schema client-generation path?
rationale: The choice defines supported API coverage, auth/scope visibility, plugin-route exposure, versioning, and upgrade compatibility, which should not be selected by cleanup automation from the current source layout alone.

options.title: Design Public Schema Contract First
options.body: Keep this issue open until maintainers choose the schema format, exposure path, covered APIs, and security/versioning rules.

options.title: Narrow To Static Artifact
options.body: Publish a versioned generated schema artifact for selected stable APIs without adding a runtime endpoint until auth and plugin-route exposure are settled.

options.title: Use Existing Protocol Schemas
options.body: Close later only if maintainers decide the TypeBox/JSON Schema and Gateway protocol docs are the supported client-generation surface instead of OpenAPI/Swagger.

recommendation.title: Design Public Schema Contract First
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until maintainers choose the schema format, exposure path, covered APIs, and security/versioning rules.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest current history signal across the Gateway protocol, HTTP routing, and external-app docs that define this product boundary.
